## mddeck v0.1.6

Two related fixes for the `mddeck --pdf` flow:

### Fixed

- **Blank PDFs.** `PRINT_MODE_CSS` only reset `.step`'s `transform`, but impress.js init applies transforms at four levels (`html`/`body` `height: 100%`, `#impress` scale, an anonymous centering wrapper, `.step`'s own `translate3d`). The first three layers had to be undone too. PDFs now correctly produce one page per slide with each slide's content visible.
- **Slides looked tiny inside a 1920×1080 page.** Marpit's scaffold hardcodes `.step { width: 1280px; height: 720px }`, so the rendered slide design was letterboxed inside the larger PDF page. `PRINT_MODE_CSS` now sizes the step box to match the page, scales the root `font-size` by `--pdf-scale` (so `em`-sized hierarchy grows proportionally), centers content with flexbox, and drops `box-shadow` in print to avoid bleed onto a trailing blank page.

### Internal

- `scripts/publish.sh` now registers a `trap 'rm -f .npmrc' EXIT` so the token-bearing `.npmrc` is removed on any exit path. Previously, if the script aborted mid-run, the rendered `.npmrc` lingered on disk.
- `packages/core/src/{marpp,marpit}_plugin.ts` header comments now document the `@marp-team/marpit/plugin.js` deep-import fragility: it works because marpit has no `exports` field. If marpit ever adds one without `./plugin`, every vendored plugin breaks at first import.

### Notes

- Public API is unchanged. Consumers on `^0.1.2` resolve to 0.1.6 on next install.
- 0.1.4 is deprecated on the registry (npm blocks unpublish from granular access tokens via 2FA). If you're on 0.1.4, go straight to 0.1.6.

### Install

```bash
npm install --save-dev @machine-w/mddeck-cli
# or
npx @machine-w/mddeck-cli presentation.md -o slides.html
```

Full changelog: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/machine-w/mddeck/blob/v0.1.6/CHANGELOG.md).
